DINOv2 patch embeddings - PCA (2D PC1/PC2 oder 3D PC1/PC2/PC3)

Axes = PCA basis of the REAL embeddings (PC1/PC2/PC3); synthetic points are projected onto it · color = real vs. synthetic · "Patches (horizontal)" thins points along the angle axis (every 2nd/3rd/4th column) · the "Regionen" checkbox colors points by mandrel/layer/housing (dark tone = real, light = synthetic) and draws the transitions on the polar image · hover a point to mark its patch.
